definitions.gloss: to take out, to bring out
definitions.explanation: To remove something from inside a container or place and bring it outside or into view.
To formally present documents, homework, or applications to someone in authority.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive). Pair: ⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (intransitive). Pattern: X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{出|だ}す (take out X).

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing action or result. {出|だ}している = 'is putting out' or 'has taken out.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{出|だ}す (send a letter)
・⟦{宿題|しゅくだい}→宿題：00812_shukudai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{出|だ}す (submit homework)
・⟦ゴミ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{出|だ}す (put out trash)
・⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{出|だ}す (speak up/make a sound)

AUXILIARY: V-stem + {出|だ}す = start doing suddenly: ⟦{走|はし}り→走る：00519_hashiru⟧{出|だ}す (start running), ⟦{泣|な}き→泣く：00655_naku⟧{出|だ}す (burst into tears).

PAIR: ⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (intransitive) - ⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧ (results came out).
